description: FFI & Embedding API (M17) — C embedding API for JACL: VM lifecycle, eval, native function registration, GC handles, struct interop, and closure-to-function-pointer trampolines via libffi.

userStories.title: Public header — jacl.h with type declarations
userStories.description: As a C developer embedding JACL, I need a single public header that declares the embedding API types so I can include one file and use JACL from my application.
acceptanceCriteria: include/jacl.h exists with JACL_API annotation macro for export/visibility
Declares opaque types: JaclVM, JaclHandle, JaclTrampoline
Re-exports JaclVal (uint64_t) and JaclType enum
All public symbols prefixed with Jacl or jacl_
#ifdef __cplusplus extern "C" guards
Version macros: JACL_VERSION_MAJOR, JACL_VERSION_MINOR, JACL_VERSION_PATCH
Header is self-contained (no transitive includes of internal headers)
Build passes, all existing tests pass

userStories.title: VM lifecycle — jacl_vm_new / jacl_vm_free
userStories.description: As a C developer, I need to create and destroy JACL VMs so I can run JACL code from my application.
acceptanceCriteria: JaclVM* jacl_vm_new(void) allocates and initializes a new VM with default settings
void jacl_vm_free(JaclVM* vm) destroys VM and frees all associated memory (GC heap, intern table, struct registry)
JaclVM* jacl_vm_new_ex(const JaclConfig* config) creates VM with custom initial_heap_size, max_heap_size, max_handles (default 1024)
Multiple VMs can coexist in the same process without interfering
jacl_vm_free on NULL is a safe no-op
Function declarations added to jacl.h
Build passes, all existing tests pass

userStories.title: Eval API — jacl_eval / jacl_eval_file
userStories.description: As a C developer, I need to evaluate JACL source code strings and get results so I can script my application.
acceptanceCriteria: JaclVal jacl_eval(JaclVM* vm, const char* source) parses, compiles, and executes JACL source, returns result
JaclVal jacl_eval_file(JaclVM* vm, const char* path) reads file and evals contents
On parse/compile/runtime error, returns an error-flagged value
bool jacl_is_error(JaclVal val) checks error flag
const char* jacl_error_message(JaclVM* vm, JaclVal err) extracts error message string
Multiple sequential jacl_eval calls share the same VM state (globals persist)
Function declarations added to jacl.h
Build passes, all existing tests pass

userStories.title: Value constructors and extractors
userStories.description: As a C developer, I need to create JACL values from C types and extract C types from JACL values so I can marshal data across the boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Constructors: jacl_nil(), jacl_bool(bool), jacl_i32(int32_t), jacl_i64(JaclVM*, int64_t), jacl_u32(uint32_t), jacl_u64(JaclVM*, uint64_t), jacl_f32(float), jacl_f64(JaclVM*, double)
jacl_string(JaclVM* vm, const char* s, size_t len) creates JACL string from C buffer
jacl_string_cstr(JaclVM* vm, const char* s) convenience for null-terminated strings
Extractors: jacl_as_i32, jacl_as_i64, jacl_as_f32, jacl_as_f64, jacl_as_bool
jacl_as_cstr(JaclVM* vm, JaclVal val, size_t* len_out) returns pointer to string data
Type query: jacl_typeof(JaclVal) returns tag/type enum
Inline types (nil, bool, i32, f32, u32) require no VM pointer
Function declarations added to jacl.h
Build passes, all existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Many of these already exist as static inline functions in value.c — this story wraps them as public API in jacl.h

userStories.title: GC handle API — pin values from C
userStories.description: As a C developer, I need to prevent the GC from collecting values I'm holding in C so that my references remain valid across GC cycles.
acceptanceCriteria: JaclHandle jacl_handle_new(JaclVM* vm, JaclVal val) creates a GC root handle
JaclVal jacl_handle_get(JaclHandle h) retrieves the value from a handle
void jacl_handle_free(JaclVM* vm, JaclHandle h) releases the handle
Handles stored as JaclVal array on JaclVM, scanned as additional GC roots during mark phase
Free handles use a free list for reuse (no per-handle heap allocation)
Default max 1024 handles, configurable via JaclConfig
Function declarations added to jacl.h
Build passes, all existing tests pass

userStories.title: Native function tag and OP_CALL dispatch
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the VM to support a native function value type so that C functions can be called from JACL bytecode.
acceptanceCriteria: Add JACL_TAG_NATIVE_FN value tag
Native function signature: typedef JaclVal (*JaclNativeFn)(JaclVM* vm, JaclVal* args, int argc)
NativeFnEntry struct stores: function pointer, name, arity (-1 for variadic)
JaclVM has a native function registry (array of NativeFnEntry, indexed by payload)
OP_CALL checks tag — if JACL_TAG_NATIVE_FN, calls C function directly without pushing bytecode call frame
Native function receives args from VM stack, return value pushed onto stack
Build passes, all existing tests pass

userStories.title: jacl_register_fn — register C functions
userStories.description: As a C developer, I need to register C functions that JACL code can call as procs so I can extend JACL with native functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: bool jacl_register_fn(JaclVM* vm, const char* name, JaclNativeFn fn, int arity) registers a native function
Registered functions callable from JACL: [my-native-fn 1 2 3]
Arity=-1 for variadic; arity mismatch produces compile-time error
Native function can return error-flagged values to propagate errors to JACL
Re-entrant: native functions can call jacl_call back into JACL
Function declaration added to jacl.h
Build passes, all existing tests pass

userStories.title: jacl_call — call JACL functions from C
userStories.description: As a C developer, I need to call JACL-defined procs from C so I can invoke callbacks and scripted logic from my host application.
acceptanceCriteria: JaclVal jacl_call(JaclVM* vm, JaclVal fn, JaclVal* args, int argc) calls a closure or native function
JaclVal jacl_call_named(JaclVM* vm, const char* name, JaclVal* args, int argc) looks up global proc by name
Returns function's return value, or error-flagged value on failure
Handles re-entrant calls (C calls JACL calls native C calls JACL)
Proper stack management: call frame pushed/popped correctly
Function declarations added to jacl.h
Build passes, all existing tests pass

userStories.title: Struct interop from C
userStories.description: As a C developer, I need to create, read, and modify JACL structs from C so I can work with structured data across the embedding boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: JaclVal jacl_struct_new(JaclVM* vm, const char* type_name, JaclVal* fields, int count) instantiates a struct
JaclVal jacl_struct_get(JaclVM* vm, JaclVal s, const char* field_name) reads a field by name
bool jacl_struct_set(JaclVM* vm, JaclVal s, const char* field_name, JaclVal value) writes a field
const char* jacl_struct_type_name(JaclVM* vm, JaclVal s) gets the struct type name
Type checking on set: returns false if value type doesn't match field type
GC write barrier triggered on struct field mutation of heap-typed fields
Function declarations added to jacl.h
Build passes, all existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Uses existing StructTypeRegistry for offset/type lookup

userStories.title: Build system — libffi detection and linking
userStories.description: As a developer building JACL, I need the build system to detect and optionally link libffi for trampoline support.
acceptanceCriteria: build.sh detects libffi via pkg-config --cflags --libs libffi (or fallback to standard paths)
If libffi found: defines JACL_HAS_LIBFFI=1, links -lffi
If libffi not found: builds without trampoline support, no error
bool jacl_has_trampolines(void) runtime query returns true/false
Build passes on macOS and Linux

userStories.title: Closure-to-function-pointer trampolines via libffi
userStories.description: As a C developer, I need to obtain a C function pointer from a JACL closure so I can pass JACL callbacks to C libraries that expect function pointers.
acceptanceCriteria: JaclTrampoline* jacl_trampoline_new(JaclVM* vm, JaclVal closure, const char* sig) creates C-callable function pointer
Signature format: i32(i32,i32) — types: void, i32, i64, u32, u64, f32, f64, ptr
void* jacl_trampoline_ptr(JaclTrampoline* t) returns raw C function pointer
void jacl_trampoline_free(JaclVM* vm, JaclTrampoline* t) releases trampoline and libffi resources
Trampoline pins closure via GC handle (prevents collection while alive)
When called: marshals C args to JaclVal, calls closure via jacl_call, marshals return back
Uses ffi_closure_alloc / ffi_prep_closure_loc from libffi
Guarded by #ifdef JACL_HAS_LIBFFI — stubs return NULL when unavailable
jacl_vm_free silently frees all outstanding trampolines
Function declarations added to jacl.h
Build passes, all existing tests pass

userStories.title: Emscripten / WASM build target
userStories.description: As a developer, I need JACL to compile to WebAssembly via Emscripten so the embedding API works in browser and WASI contexts.
acceptanceCriteria: emcc compiles all of JACL to .wasm + .js module
Embedding API functions exported via EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE or -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS
Threading primitives in platform.h compile as no-ops under Emscripten
GC works in single-threaded mode
Trampoline API stubs return NULL when called (runtime unsupported, not compile error)
Basic test: create VM, eval expression, extract result — works in Node.js
Build passes with emcc
userStories.notes: NxM scheduler degrades to single-worker event loop under Emscripten

userStories.title: E2E tests — embedding basics
userStories.description: As a developer, I need end-to-end tests for the core embedding API to verify correctness.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: create VM, eval [+ 1 2], extract i32 result, verify == 3, free VM
Test: eval with syntax error returns error-flagged value
Test: eval with runtime error returns error-flagged value with message
Test: create all value types from C, round-trip through eval, extract back
Test: string creation, extraction, and GC survival via handle
Test: multiple sequential evals share global state
Test: multiple independent VMs don't interfere
All tests pass, no memory leaks (ASAN clean)

userStories.title: E2E tests — native functions and jacl_call
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for native function registration, calling conventions, and jacl_call.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: register native function, call from JACL, verify args and return value
Test: variadic native function receives correct argc/argv
Test: native function returns error value, JACL propagates error flag
Test: native function calls jacl_call back into JACL (re-entrant)
Test: jacl_call_named looks up and calls a global proc
Test: register multiple native functions, call them in sequence
All tests pass, no memory leaks

userStories.title: E2E tests — GC handles
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests proving the handle API keeps values alive across GC cycles.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: create handle, force GC, verify value survives
Test: free handle, force GC, verify value is collected
Test: create many handles (100+), GC stress, verify all survive
Test: handle to a struct — struct fields survive GC
Test: handle to a closure — closure and upvalues survive GC
All tests pass, no memory leaks

userStories.title: E2E tests — struct interop and trampolines
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for struct manipulation from C and closure-to-function-pointer trampolines.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: create struct from C via jacl_struct_new, read fields, verify values
Test: mutate struct field from C, read back from JACL, verify change
Test: type mismatch on struct set returns false
Test: create trampoline from JACL closure, call C function pointer, verify closure executes
Test: trampoline with various signatures (void return, multiple args, different types)
Test: free trampoline, verify closure becomes collectible
Test: trampoline used as callback to C qsort — sort array using JACL comparator
